content.what_it_is: A V35/0x24 text-form compiler module-interface artifact for sponge_module, generated from sponge_gpu.f90. It exposes a CUDA sponge-damping kernel and GPU wrapper together with their model dimensions, launch geometry, hydrodynamic device arrays, imported runtime APIs, and opaque compiler metadata (lines 1-970).
entities: sponge_module compiler-interface artifact generated from sponge_gpu.f90 (lines 1-2)
Dependencies on iso_c_binding, NVIDIA accelerator and CUDA runtime APIs, cuTENSOR types/API, GPU reductions, sort, cudafor_la, mod_cuda, global, and param (lines 4-16)
Imported zero, global domain dimensions, GPU launch geometry, and eta_d, u_d, v_d, sponge_d, and mask_d device fields (lines 45-68, 270-290)
sponge_damping_kernel device kernel with mloc and nloc arguments (lines 290-300)
Imported cuTENSOR enum/type interfaces and CUDA pointer attributes (lines 69-269)
Opaque compiler declarations, attributes, reference maps, argument tables, and type records (lines 306-970)
unresolved: The V35/0x24 format and the meanings of its D/S/R/A/F/J/V/T/X/Z numeric records, flags, offsets, and bit masks are not defined within the artifact, so the kernel implementation and most serialized relationships cannot be reconstructed from this file alone (lines 1, 17-970).
Several unnamed real constant payloads are stored only as compiler integer encodings, without source-level names or literals in the artifact (lines 270-275).
The timestamp 06/12/2026 does not state whether its date order is month/day or day/month (line 3).
